headline: Flat's to Friendly's project feedback, Ebikes, and an Ashley Reservoir hike with South Hadley.
summary: Old business includes the Safer Streets planning map, the comprehensive plan, and an October infrastructure walk. A World Day of Remembrance for road traffic victims is planned for November 15, 2026.
